questions.q: Which of the following is a characteristic of 'Development' rather than 'Growth'?

questions.explanation: Growth involves measurable, physical changes like size.

questions.q: The period characterized by rapid physical changes, puberty, and identity formation is:
questions.explanation: Adolescence (12-18 years) is marked by these major changes.

questions.q: The principle that development proceeds from the head downward is known as:
The principle that development proceeds from the center of the body outward is:

questions.explanation: Unlike development, growth stops when the skeleton reaches maturity.

questions.q: During which stage is sensory exploration and basic motor skill acquisition most rapid?
questions.explanation: Infants learn primarily through their senses and basic movement.

questions.q: Learning to walk is an example of:
questions.explanation: It involves the qualitative maturation of the nervous and muscular systems.
